chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: Non-violent Cooperation
subtitle: Don't spend too much time on physical fights. We have our own things to do, don't we?

items.text: Someone leaves immediately like a player given the red card, while the other chooses a way that's more imperceptible.
In a corner where nobody cares, Melania closes the door to the electric switch box gently. In her hand is a fuse that has just been replaced.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: All the fuses were changed recently.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I'm guessing the head of security here is a pretty tough nut to crack.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: But unfortunately, too much attention to the Guidance on Security will probably lead to carelessness in other areas.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Transferring all the human security staff and relying solely on the patrol and precaution of robots ... The consequence is a 30-second blind spot in the monitored areas every 4 hours 13 minutes and 2 seconds.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: That gives you the chance to change the fuse here.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: That's right, Ms. Acey!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I will prove the ineffectiveness of the Guidance on Security in person and start the show at just the right moment!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Then, our next plan is ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: ... to meet up with all the security robots.
She checks the fuses in the electric switch box again, then closes the door of the monitor room carefully.
In the spacious exhibition hall, a common girl is wandering through the crowd.
She "accidentally" bumps into the security robots again and again, like a careless visitor.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Suspicious invader detected. Locating ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Phew! The last one ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Um? You seem a bit smarter than the other robots.

items.speaker: Security Robot
items.text: Locating failed. Initiate Programme II, Pushpin Glue Gun.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Oops!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: No noise. I have to be quick. Watch out for its detectors!
Once again, Melania dodges the detectors of the security robot and waits on its path.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Eroj Exchange!
In a burst of light, the bullets hidden in the barrels of the security robot suddenly appear in Ms. Acey's stomach.
As a fair exchange, the bullets tailored by Melania are now in their barrels.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Look out.
The handbag spits out a steel core ammo that originally belonged to the robot. Her tone is serious. It seems she is wary of the robot in front of her.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Tut-tut!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It's not tear gas or electrode bug spray. These robots are actually using real military ammunition.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: This violates the Guidance on Security that has been strictly followed all the time.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Is Mr. Iverson actually new at security?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Heh heh, no, no way. The only possible reason is that he's unscrupulous.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: For his “security announcement.”

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Humph. I know their slogan, "New Humans' Promise: The Rimet Cup will be absolutely secure."

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Everyone's happy to accept the hyperbole ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: ... and believes it to be true.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Heh.
Melania looks at the clock on the wall. It's 1 hour and 15 minutes to closing.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: We need to hurry.
The widest vent is usually located in the restroom.
They are connected to the ceilings of other rooms, often regarded as hidden roads.
Melania struggles to move in the ventilating ducts, trying her best to avoid the dust and debris around her.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Turn 45 degrees left and move 13 steps farther …

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: The core device of the ventilation system is located in the third room, on the left side of the exhibition hall.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: There's no necessary living conditions and lighting.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Normally, no one will be there.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I will have plenty of time to adjust the airflow.
The world inside the ventilation ducts falls silent.
Melania can clearly hear the sound of crawling that she deliberately keeps down.
And the closer to the target, the stronger ...
... the pungent odor from far to near.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It smells strange ... like the sour flame wine that's over fermented.
BANG!
A face coated in colourful bubble water appears abruptly around the corner of the vent.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Haahh!!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: There you are!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You are ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: What's going on? There's actually an ambush here!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Boohoo! *puking* It hurts all over, but is this my revery? Or, really, heaven?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: I can't tell. Could it be a form of art created by the subtle sense of danger I'm feeling right now and the dirty air?!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Come to me. Come to me! You are my Muse!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ugh, oh! Hey, let me go! Let go!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Damn! Did I just bump into a human security staff who got fired and went crazy?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Alright. I'll just think of it as an unexpected additional exam question.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Try this! The ground grappling that Father used to teach me!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Whoa! Inspiration. My inspiration never lasts long ...

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Hiss, ahh! I've never experienced such vivid pain from the revery.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Hm? Still holding on?! One more time!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Whew!
The war swiftly ends with Diggers's crushing defeat.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Whew! Finally, it's all settled.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: This ... this is not revery. This is a terrorist attack!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Cunning ... cunning action, shameful violence!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Iverson, you set an ambush here? You crazy addict of imprisonment and war! I must blow your cover!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Hmm?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Are you not one of them?!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Of course not!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ahem. Sorry …

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Stay ... stay away from me!

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: You must be the demon that Iverson summoned! You are more horrific than those robots!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: If I say it's all a misunderstanding, could ... would you understand?

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Huuhh! What do you think?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: A little reckless.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Ms. Acey, I know, I'm too nervous ...

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: In no way is there any possibility for him to be a security staff.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: It sounds like a joke.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: I must claim that violence is the antonym of art. We should resort to a more sensible means to fight.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: This is the reason for us to oppose those Iversons who abuse the use of force!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Couldn't agree more.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I don't intend to abuse the use of force, either. It's the biggest difference between Iverson's company and ours.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Really? I still feel pain in my neck.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It's … it's just an accident. Huuhh! As compensation, I will get you out.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Fine. Apology accepted.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: When will we start off?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: In five minutes.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I have to change the terminal valve in the room first. Adjust the position of the deflector in the duct and change the airflow from the spiral fan.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Abundant magnetic glue will be blown out of the ventilation ducts by the spiral fan and adhere to the robots.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Heh heh. The fine glue will paralyse them completely.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: After that, you could just waltz away.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Sounds like a big project. Do you need my help?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Absolutely.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Stay as far away as possible from the regulator valve behind you.

items.speaker: Diggers
items.text: Ugh ...
TO BE CONTINUED ...
